value: Minimal master workbook used as input for manuscript calculations; supplementary tables should be derived from this file or from repository outputs.
Use observations for real/simulated, mixed models, leave-one-benchmark-out, read length, benchmark purpose, Edgren sensitivity, and precision-recall analyses.
This workbook is not the formatted supplementary information file; it is a clean analysis input.

dataset_metadata column: the same biological data (same libraries or the same simulated design) used in several benchmarks share a group; otherwise group = dataset_id. Use it for crossed random effects. Cell colours are informal and not used by the analyses.
